'''PS-29-3''', also known as "'''Hammer'''," was a [[TIE pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. PS-29-3<ref name="JKTCG" /> flew under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Shadow Three (Shadow wing)|Shadow Three]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|48|PS-29-3}}</ref> in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Shadow wing]].<ref name="JKTCG" /> He<ref name="JKTCG2" /> recorded the highest score in [[Imperial Academy/Legends|academy]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] simulator drills, a fact that caught [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti's]] attention.<ref name="JKTCG" /> PS-29-3's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] had a command system capable of coordinating the combined power of the entire Shadow [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]].<ref name="JKTCG2" /> He wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] TIE pilot [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] and [[Armor/Legends|helmet]], and had designs on being the leading [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of Shadow wing.<ref name="JKTCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
PS-29-3 was created for a card in the [[Premiere (Jedi Knights TCG)|''Premiere'']] set of [[Decipher]]'s [[2001]] ''[[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]]'',<ref name="JKTCG" /> with his name simultaneously being used in the gameplay text of a second card in the set.<ref name="JKTCG2" />
